decision_question: Is this recommendation packet evidence-supported, useful for execution, and safe within its stated assessment scope?
acceptance_criteria: Material claims trace to current source or measured evidence.
Local, remote, live, CI, analytical and unknown evidence remain distinct.
No model-confidence, performance, security, accessibility or translation overclaims.
Tasks have implementable scope, sequencing and acceptance evidence.
No implementation/publication is falsely claimed or implicitly authorized.
Owner voice, public-private boundaries and preservation decisions remain intact.
